To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of a JINI-based approach for the integration of tools in a heterogeneous network environment can be successfully applied to the tool integration in the field of printed circuit board design.

(i) the proposed approach is feasible for the integration and management of tools in a heterogeneous computer network and (ii) the approach is flexible enough to integrate and manage tools in other application areas.
The Jini technology can be successfully used to implement a tool integration and management framework in a heterogeneous network of workstations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and implementation of a tool for the automatic integration of tools in the context of the development of a printed circuit board.
the development of methods and tools for the dynamic integration of heterogeneous software tools.
the development of methods for the dynamic tool management in heterogeneous computer networks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the current state of the art of tool integration and management in heterogeneous computer networks is not yet sufficient for the demands of the modern software engineering environment, and that there is a need for more research in this area.
the current status of research on the integration of heterogeneous software systems is still in its infancy.

the use of XML in the field of tool integration and management is a promising and powerful approach, but it is still too early to say that XML is the ultimate solution for tool management in heterogeneous computer networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new approach for dynamic tool management by combining SNMP and JINI.
we have developed a prototype for a dynamic integration of tool services in heterogeneous computer networks.
the presented work is a first step towards the realization of a tool management system that is able to handle the complexity of a modern computer network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to build a system that can handle all the different kinds of tools that we have used.
the use of a standard protocol such as SNMP is not sufficient to provide the necessary functionality for the integration and management of tools in heterogeneous networks.
it is possible to integrate and manage software in a heterogeneous network using a combination of JINI, SNMP and XML.
